source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The Help review moved the channel-support action to openLinkText where sibling Help routes already lived. Accepted URLs are fixed support articles, with daily/beta chosen there. A new preference was questioned when it merely stored a hardcoded slug. This supports reuse of the existing dispatcher for this family; do not introduce a repository-wide ban on URL preferences.
title: Keep common menu actions in the existing shared URL dispatcher
